   141	class Metrics(object):
   142	    """Backlog statistics over the union of all banks' residents.
   143	
   144	    For a departing packet p (queried immediately before its removal):
   145	      x = number of residents with rank strictly smaller than rank(p),
   146	      y = number of residents with rank == rank(p) and ordinal < ordinal(p),
   147	      z = number of residents with any different rank.
   148	    Uses a Fenwick tree over compressed ranks (for x) and a flat Fenwick
   149	    tree grouped by rank over ordinals (for y).
   150	    """
   151	
   152	    __slots__ = ('D', 'flat_n', 'fenX', 'fenY', 'cnt', 'total',
   153	                 'ridx', 'gstart', 'gpos1', 'flat')
   154	
   155	    def __init__(self, rank_list):
   156	        n = len(rank_list)
   157	        rankvals = sorted(set(rank_list))
   158	        D = len(rankvals)
   159	        ridx_of = {}
   160	        for i in range(D):
   161	            ridx_of[rankvals[i]] = i
   162	        groups = [None] * D
   163	        for v in range(D):
   164	            groups[v] = []
   165	        for o in range(n):
   166	            groups[ridx_of[rank_list[o]]].append(o)
   167	        gstart = [0] * D
   168	        off = 0
   169	        for v in range(D):
   170	            gstart[v] = off
   171	            off += len(groups[v])
   172	        self.D = D
   173	        self.flat_n = off
   174	        self.fenX = [0] * (D + 1)
   175	        self.fenY = [0] * (off + 1)
   176	        self.cnt = [0] * D
   177	        self.total = 0
   178	        self.ridx = [0] * n
   179	        self.gstart = [0] * n
   180	        self.gpos1 = [0] * n
   181	        self.flat = [0] * n
   182	        for v in range(D):
   183	            gs = gstart[v]
   184	            g = groups[v]
   185	            for i in range(len(g)):
   186	                o = g[i]
   187	                self.ridx[o] = v
   188	                self.gstart[o] = gs
   189	                self.gpos1[o] = i + 1
   190	                self.flat[o] = gs + i + 1
   191	
   192	    def insert(self, o):
   193	        v = self.ridx[o]
   194	        t = self.fenX
   195	        n = self.D
   196	        i = v + 1
   197	        while i <= n:
   198	            t[i] += 1
   199	            i += i & (-i)
   200	        t2 = self.fenY
   201	        m = self.flat_n
   202	        j = self.flat[o]
   203	        while j <= m:
   204	            t2[j] += 1
   205	            j += j & (-j)
   206	        self.cnt[v] += 1
   207	        self.total += 1
   208	
   209	    def remove_and_query(self, o):
   210	        v = self.ridx[o]
   211	        t = self.fenX
   212	        i = v
   213	        x = 0
   214	        while i > 0:
   215	            x += t[i]
   216	            i -= i & (-i)
   217	        t2 = self.fenY
   218	        gs = self.gstart[o]
   219	        p1 = self.gpos1[o]
   220	        j = gs + p1 - 1
   221	        y = 0
   222	        while j > 0:
   223	            y += t2[j]
   224	            j -= j & (-j)
   225	        j = gs
   226	        while j > 0:
   227	            y -= t2[j]
   228	            j -= j & (-j)
   229	        z = self.total - self.cnt[v]
   230	        n = self.D
   231	        i = v + 1
   232	        while i <= n:
   233	            t[i] -= 1
   234	            i += i & (-i)
   235	        m = self.flat_n
   236	        k = self.flat[o]
   237	        while k <= m:
   238	            t2[k] -= 1
   239	            k += k & (-k)
   240	        self.cnt[v] -= 1
   241	        self.total -= 1
   242	        return x, y, z

   245	def _controller(W, H, borders, R):
   246	    """One integer border-controller update. Returns (W, borders)."""
   247	    for r in range(R):
   248	        W[r] = W[r] // 2 + H[r]
   249	    S = 0
   250	    mn = W[0]
   251	    mx = W[0]
   252	    for r in range(R):
   253	        w = W[r]
   254	        S += w
   255	        if w < mn:
   256	            mn = w
   257	        if w > mx:
   258	            mx = w
   259	    if S > 0 and R > 1 and (2 * R * mn < S or R * mx > 2 * S):
   260	        # smallest index of minimum weight
   261	        a = 0
   262	        mv = W[0]
   263	        for i in range(1, R):
   264	            if W[i] < mv:
   265	                mv = W[i]
   266	                a = i
   267	        if a == 0:
   268	            b = 1
   269	        elif a == R - 1:
   270	            b = R - 2
   271	        else:
   272	            b = a - 1 if W[a - 1] <= W[a + 1] else a + 1
   273	        if a < b:
   274	            lo, hi = a, b
   275	        else:
   276	            lo, hi = b, a
   277	        mW = W[:lo] + [W[lo] + W[hi]] + W[lo + 1:hi] + W[hi + 1:]
   278	        mb = borders[:hi] + borders[hi + 1:]
   279	        # eligible ranges: integer width >= 2; max weight, smallest index
   280	        best = -1
   281	        bw = 0
   282	        for i in range(R - 1):
   283	            if mb[i + 1] - mb[i] >= 2:
   284	                if best < 0 or mW[i] > bw:
   285	                    best = i
   286	                    bw = mW[i]
   287	        if best >= 0:
   288	            lob = mb[best]
   289	            hib = mb[best + 1]
   290	            mid = (lob + hib) // 2
   291	            w = mW[best]
   292	            W = mW[:best] + [w // 2, w - w // 2] + mW[best + 1:]
   293	            borders = mb[:best + 1] + [mid] + mb[best + 1:]
   294	        # else: cancel; keep old borders and the updated, unmerged W
   295	    return W, borders
